The Business Playbook Series / 02

The Missed Revenue Playbook

How to Find, Evaluate and Recover Revenue Your Business Is Already Positioned to Capture

By Timothy Madu · First edition

Revenue opportunities

Revenue opportunities deserve careful evaluation. This playbook explores how to examine opportunities a business may already be positioned to capture, while considering costs, operational demands and customer impact.

An opportunity estimate is not a verified result. Keep baseline performance, attribution, incremental effect and contribution in view when assessing what an improvement actually achieves.

Publication and purchase details will be updated when confirmed.

What you will explore

Key takeaways.

  • Identify opportunities within the existing business.
  • Evaluate likely benefits alongside cost and feasibility.
  • Distinguish estimates from observed, attributable results.
About the author

Timothy Madu

Timothy Madu is a business owner, entrepreneur and author based in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, Nigeria. He owns KC TIMO AUTOMOBILES. His Business Playbook Series focuses on practical questions about customer experience, revenue opportunities and business improvement.
